newsitem.title: USA: Mestek declines comment on share activity.
newsitem.headline: Mestek declines comment on share activity.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Wednesday Mestek Inc has declined to comment on whether there are corporate developments that may explain the unusual market activity in its stock.
In late afternoon trading, the stock was up 2-1/8 to 19-5/8 on turnover of 20,000 shares.

In view of the unusual activity in Mestek's stock, the Big Board said, it contacted the company and requested a public statement indicating whether there are any corporate developments which may explain the activitiy.
"The company stated that its policy is not to comment on unusual market activity or rumors," the NYSE said.
